messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx and latency observed in AWS us-east-2. Affects: Hosted API endpoints in us-east-2 and several Dedicated pools pinned to that region. Alert from CloudWatch: increased 5xx rate and backend latency spike. PagerDuty: P123456 triggered.

sanjeev: seeing the same in grafana, p95 spikes to ~1.8s and 5xx rate up ~4% for /v1/generate in us-east-2. Confirming control plane also logged 503s to the model runtime.

maria: @sanjeev are Dedicated pools impacted or just hosted?

sanjeev: both. Dedicated pools with nodes in us-east-2 show higher request latency and some health checks flapping. Hosted API traffic routed there is returning 502/503.

leo: paging oncall now. @pagerduty escalate to infra-oncall, infra-lead.

pagerduty: @infra-oncall alerted (incident P123456).

amanda: quick customer-impact check — any customers in our status page affected? I can correlate top customers by region.

karen-cs: we already have 2 support tickets mentioning timeouts for apps in US East. Customers A and B report 5xx since ~09:03 UTC.

ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: shift routing for Hosted API away from us-east-2 to nearest healthy region (us-east-1) for routes with cross-region allowed. Recommend temporary routing policy change + model fallback to smaller variant if bursty.

maria: stepwise plan: 1) add routing exclusion for us-east-2 (fast) 2) scale Dedicated pool cross-region capacity (may take minutes) 3) set fallback variant to reduce error + drop latency.

sanjeev: implementing exclusion now. Running command: ```sh
# remove us-east-2 from region routing for hosted
redwoodctl routing update --exclude-region us-east-2 --scope hosted-api
```

leo: oncall handoff — i'm taking first 20m triage, then @maria rotates in. stating in thread.

sanjeev: exclusion applied. Monitoring logs. Early telemetry: 5xx rate for hosted dropped from 4% -> 0.7% in ~45s for routed customers. Some Dedicated pools still flapping because nodes are pinned.

amanda: notifying top-affected customers: message queued for A & B, advising we are routing around region and investigating Dedicated pool health.

karen-cs: ack, I'll send canned note and offer status calls if they want.

maria: for Dedicated pools: initiating cross-region scale/bootstrap of replacement nodes (us-east-1). Command: ```sh
redwoodctl dedicated migrate --pool-id pool-0a1b2c --from us-east-2 --to us-east-1 --type warm
``` This will keep serving while new nodes spin up.

ops-bot: Note: fallback model variants will increase per-token CPU but reduce tail latency. Toggle plan: set policy for routes matching high-latency to model-variant-lite.

sanjeev: starting health drain on affected Dedicated nodes to avoid more 5xx. ```sh
redwoodctl node drain --region us-east-2 --selector pool=pool-0a1b2c
```

leo: prod-deploy-bot: A/B routing change deployed to edge config v2026-03-15-42.

incident-bot: UPDATE: AWS us-east-2 reports partial API Gateway control plane degradation and intermittent ENI attach failures (link: <https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/US-EAST-2-2026-03>). ETA unknown.

maria: observed node reboot storms on some Dedicated VMs — likely stuck on ENI attach. We're forcing fallback nodes in us-east-1 and scaling out there now.

amanda: customer-impact summary for postmortem: ~3% of Hosted traffic routed through us-east-2 during window impacted with elevated errors; 5 enterprise Dedicated pools with nodes pinned to us-east-2 saw degraded throughput and transient 5xx. No data loss, retryable errors. Preparing CS outreach.

karen-cs: sending high-priority notes to affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery.

leo: metrics show successful routing away from us-east-2; p95 dropped to normal for hosted. Dedicated pool migrations at 40% capacity restored. Still monitoring node drain completion.

sanjeev: set temporary SLA suspension flag for affected customers (internal only) to avoid automated SLA credits while we collect root cause.

ops-bot: checklist (in thread):
- [x] PagerDuty alert acknowledged
- [x] Routing exclusion applied for hosted API
- [x] Customer comms initiated
- [x] Dedicated pool scale/migrate started
- [ ] Full Dedicated node drain completed
- [ ] Root cause RCA with AWS and follow-up tickets

maria: handoff note: @leo i'm handing primary ownership — pacing through remaining drains and AWS case. will loop infra-lead for RCA.

leo: ack. I'll run final verification and close incident once all Dedicated pools show stable health across regions and AWS confirms progress.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: transitioned to recovery mode at 09:12 UTC. Targeting incident close after 1 hour of stable metrics.

amanda: post-incident actions to assign: create AWS support case with ENI logs, add cross-region autoscale runbook, update status page with postmortem link.

karen-cs: prepping customer follow-up template for tomorrow.

leo: closing loop for now — will post final timeline + impact table once we have AWS RCA and logs. Good work team. :clap:
